June Osaka-jo Hall card that often resets the title picture.

How Dominion connects

  • Location: Osaka-jo Hall — Dominion is New Japan's June show at Osaka-jo Hall.
  • Topic: NJPW — Dominion is New Japan's mid-year title card.

What is Dominion?

Dominion at Osaka-jo Hall is New Japan's mid-year pay-per-view, repeatedly used for IWGP title changes between Wrestle Kingdom and the G1.

Key threads lead to Osaka-jo Hall and NJPW.
